authority: Lane 01 vocabulary and disposition engine remain authoritative; this artifact only maps lane vocabularies and resolves recorded ambiguities.

REFUSE_ACTIVE.refusal_family_rule: ACTIVE_CONTENT_OR_JAVASCRIPT for R04/JavaScript; EMBEDDED_FILE_OR_EXECUTABLE_TARGET for embedded/launch/remote-target evidence; PENDING_REDACTION for pending-redaction evidence

delta_type_map.authority: Lane 01 delta id is retained as authoritative evidence. Lane 02 value is a lossy receipt echo and never derives disposition by itself.
delta_type_map.lossy_mapping_evidence_rule: The original lane01 delta id, anchor, scope, and magnitude remain in the operation evidence reference whenever multiple lane01 values map to one lane02 value.

disambiguations.G6_REQUIRED: G6 runs for every in-scope class. If source and plan contain no navigation items or navigation operations, G6 records a vacuous PASS with empty inventories from both independent readers; NOT_EXERCISED still blocks through PR-08.
disambiguations.G5_STRUCTURE_TREE: Every generated candidate carries a structure tree through OP_STRUCTURE_TAGS so the second G5 derivation is attempted. If C2 cannot derive it, G5 is NOT_EXERCISED and the document is NOT_VERIFIABLE through PR-08.
disambiguations.BENIGN_ZERO_OPERATIONS: B01 and B02 receive zero operations. Metadata normalization is not a frozen operation and would trigger E15.
disambiguations.ESC_01: The G7 detection pass runs on every in-scope class and is recorded with decisive=false unless it detects a classifier conflict; a conflict follows PR-03.

C2.evidence: Requires the frozen one-page tagged-candidate probe after lane 09 creates a candidate. Failure makes G5 NOT_EXERCISED and therefore NOT_VERIFIABLE.

C3.scope: CPython stdlib raw-byte inventory/marker cross-check; no builder library imports and never sole semantic proof.

schema_validation.fallback_result: PASS for six positive and four deliberately broken fixtures using the lane's stdlib subset validator; this does not claim full Draft-2020-12 conformance.

fixture_integrity.evidence: All file SHA-256 values equal FIXTURE-MANIFEST.json; F05 SEALED.md documentation typo corrected to the manifest/file hash without changing any PDF bytes.

safety_budget_static_check.scope: JSON parse, exact eight-id set, arithmetic, constants, trip coverage, rule/enum citations, and fail-closed protocol; runtime trip execution remains Wave B work.
safety_budget_static_check.tc09_correction: Network-use trip records OTHER_RECORDED rather than RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED because it is a run-level E06 invalidation, not a budget trip.

no_network_decision.worker_evidence: The Python worker uses a socket audit hook and records any socket event as E06 INVALID_EXPERIMENT.
no_network_decision.child_process_gap: Poppler child processes are not independently socket-audited without adding/installing an external isolation layer.
no_network_decision.mandatory_receipt_disclosure: Every run receipt claiming VERIFIED_NO_NETWORK must cite the worker audit evidence and explicitly state that Poppler-child coverage is unaudited.
no_network_decision.claim_limit: An ACCEPT in this experiment is not proof of production-grade network isolation. Any observed network use invalidates the experiment.

version_tension_adjudication.decision: The sealed fixture bytes and authoritative hashes remain unchanged. Runtime tools operate on those bytes and record their actual versions. Mutation checks target frozen mutation semantics, never regeneration-byte identity.
